summary.intent: Commit an unstaged learnings document to a dedicated docs branch rather than main.
summary.outcome: A docs branch was created from latest main and the learnings file was staged and committed successfully.

repo: The repo uses a .learnings/ directory with date-prefixed markdown files to capture session learnings (e.g., 2026-03-30-worktree-e2e-env-setup.md).
Learnings files are committed on a separate docs branch, not directly to main.

code.finding: Documents worktree-based E2E environment setup patterns discovered on 2026-03-30.

workflow: Learnings are captured as standalone markdown files and committed separately from feature work to keep history clean.
Docs branches are branched from latest main before committing documentation-only changes.
